title: Moses kills an Egyptian and flees to Midian
summary: At 40 Moses kills an Egyptian who was striking a Hebrew and flees from Pharaoh to Midian (Exod 2:11-15; Acts 7:23-29).
description: The age of 40 comes from Acts 7:23. Moses stayed 40 years in Midian (Acts 7:30). CFAH-6 identifies Moses with Amenemhat IV (Argument 4 §13).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 4: Ussher, Annals (1658): 1531 BC (no higher-tier year available).
